turns.content: I need a website for my cleaning business
I clean houses. Can you just make me a website?
Now let me generate the logo and then build the header and footer in parallel.Now let me build the header and footer simultaneously:Now let me build the homepage:
Looks great — let's add a services & pricing page

The Services & Pricing page is live at `/services`. It includes all three cleaning packages with staggered image/text layouts, itemized checklists, transparent starting prices, a FAQ section, and a CTA at the bottom.
Looks good! But how do people actually get in touch with me? I don't see my phone number or anything.

Your phone number is actually in the header and footer already — but let me add a proper Contact page with a quote request form so customers can easily reach you.The Contact page is live at `/contact` — it shows your phone number, email, hours, and service area prominently on the left, with a quote request form on the right where customers can select their service type, number of bedrooms, and preferred schedule. Click "Contact" in the nav to check it out.
That looks much better, but those aren't my real phone number or email — can you put in a spot where I can fill in my own contact info?

I'll create a central config file for your business info, then update all the places that reference it at once.Now update all files to use this config:Now update the pages:Now update the contact and services pages:All your contact info now lives in one place: `src/lib/business-info.ts`. Just open that file and update your real phone number, email, hours, and service area — every page on the site will update automatically.

That's perfect, thank you! The site looks great.

DONE

So glad it came together well! Your site is looking sharp — homepage, services & pricing, and contact page all set. Don't forget to update `src/lib/business-info.ts` with your real phone number, email, and hours when you're ready.When you're ready to take the next step, publishing the site makes it live for customers to find you.
